_comment: TRICK TARGET: LEGION LEADERSHIP + TEMUR BATTLE RAGE ON THE FIRECAT, turn 4 (Claude-play sweep g15, seed 50015).
Unmorph Firecat, Leadership + Battle Rage on it (6 sources: 3 SG, Hierarch, 2 Birds; 4 red): (14 + 1) x 2 = 30
>= 19. Pre-fix both pumps went to the first creature: win turn 5.
DISCRIMINATING (Morph INT-5, logs/morph/diag1-report.md): before the fix the plan-signature dedup keyed a
solo-target trick by NAME only, so every plan differing only in the trick's TARGET merged into the first one
enumerated -- the first creature in battlefield order (the Ignoble Hierarch here). The search never pumped the
real attacker; it now keys the target (#TT, both signature builders) and finds the Claude-play kill.
